data.name: Durdanah
data.long_meaning: Durdanah is an Arabic name for girls, meaning 'bright light'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'durr', which means 'pearl' or 'jewel'. The name signifies the radiance and brilliance of a precious gem, and is often given to girls born during the spring season.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Durdanah is believed to carry deep spiritual significance. It is said to represent the inner light of the soul, and is believed to bring joy, happiness, and prosperity to those who bear this name.

In the rich cultural tapestry of Islamic tradition, the name Durdanah represents the beauty and intrinsic value of harmonious relationships, as well as the promise of brilliance, success and prosperity in all aspects of life.
